name: Does cabinet refacing include new hardware and accessories?

mainEntity.name: Does cabinet refacing include new hardware and accessories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cabinet refacing projects typically include the installation of new hardware, such as hinges, pulls, and knobs, which are essential for completing the refreshed look and enhancing functionality. This provides an excellent opportunity to upgrade to modern soft-close hinges or stylish new handles that complement your chosen door style and overall design. Depending on your customized renovation plan, it can also involve integrating new accessories like rollout shelves, lazy Susans, or drawer organizers. AKN Design Group ensures that all components, from the visible hardware to interior organizational features, contribute to a cohesive and highly functional space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet refacing generally includes new hardware like hinges, pulls, and knobs to complete the refreshed look. It can also integrate new accessories such as rollout shelves for enhanced functionality.
